title: LGMT: A Tool for Testing the Logical Reasoning Reliability of LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.32627v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly serve as reasoning components in modern software systems, yet a model that answers a logical query correctly can contradict itself when the same problem is restated in an equivalent form. Static benchmarks evaluate queries in isolation and therefore fail to expose such inconsistencies. To address this limitation, we present LGMT, an open-source tool that detects reasoning inconsistencies through metamorphic relations grounded in first-order logic. Given a source test case in premise-conclusion form, LGMT generates logically equivalent follow-up cases and checks whether the model's entailment predictions agree across the pair, without ground-truth labels. The tool provides 20 built-in metamorphic relations, supports custom ones verified by the Z3 theorem prover, and runs from a CLI or a web studio, including an offline mock mode requiring no API key. translated_title: LGMT：一个用于测试大语言模型逻辑推理可靠性的工具
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地在现代软件系统中充当推理组件，然而一个能够正确回答逻辑查询的模型，在以等价形式重述同一问题时可能会自相矛盾。静态基准测试孤立地评估各个查询，因此无法暴露这种不一致性。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了LGMT，一个基于一阶逻辑的蜕变关系来检测推理不一致性的开源工具。给定一个前提-结论形式的源测试用例，LGMT会生成逻辑等价的后续测试用例，并检查模型的蕴含预测在测试对之间是否一致，且无需真实标签。该工具提供20个内置的蜕变关系，支持经Z3定理证明器验证的自定义关系，并可通过命令行界面（CLI）或网页工作室运行，还包含无需API密钥的离线模拟模式。在六种广泛使用的LLM上通过内置基准……
tldr: 本文提出开源工具LGMT，利用基于一阶逻辑的蜕变关系生成逻辑等价测试对，在无需真实标签的情况下有效检测大语言模型在等价问题重述中的推理不一致性。
